requirement:
The model-facing search and `finish_search` tool descriptions MUST give the
same selection guidance as
{cite}`requirements.authoring.search_accounting.instructions`.
rationale:
**Obligation.** `requirements.authoring.finish_search.description` says the model-facing search and `finish_search` tool descriptions MUST give the same selection guidance as `requirements.authoring.search_accounting.instructions`. That guidance has these parts:
- Close every delivered search before submitting.
- Include a tag only if its snippet was used to justify the conclusion without an additional source read.
- Entries whose source was read anyway may be omitted, and including them is harmless.
- Use an empty `used` list when no entries qualify, including for an empty search.
- `finish_search` records dependencies and does not request more source.

The "search" tools that deliver a `search_id` are `ripgrep` and `ast_grep`.

**Test.** `src/authoring/tools.rs#mod[tests]/fn[finish_search_advertises_the_accounting_schema_and_selection_rule]` is marked `{test}` for this requirement. It reads the real descriptions from `definitions()` and asserts the guidance as substring checks.
- **`finish_search` description:**
  - "snippets you used to justify your conclusion without an additional source read"
  - "Entries whose source you also read may be omitted; including them is harmless"
  - "Use used:[] when no entries qualify, including an empty search"
  - "Every delivered search must be finished before submission"
  - "{search_id, finished:true}"
  - "no additional source is delivered"
  - the parameter explanation and a worked example
- **`ripgrep` and `ast_grep` descriptions**, in a loop over both names:
  - "tags whose snippets you used to justify your conclusion without an additional source read"
  - "Entries whose source you also read may be omitted; including them is harmless"
  - "Use an empty used list if no entries qualify"
  - "Before submitting, call finish_search"
  - the tool-routing sentence

It also asserts the `finish_search` parameter schema.

**Mapping.**
- Closing before submission is covered by "Before submitting, call finish_search" on the search tools and "Every delivered search must be finished before submission" on `finish_search`.
- The selection rule, the omission and harmless clause, and the empty-list clause are each asserted on both the search tools and `finish_search`.
- "Records dependencies and does not request more source" is covered on `finish_search` by "record dependencies" in its opening phrase and by "no additional source is delivered".

**Judgment calls.**
- The search descriptions say "Use an empty used list if no entries qualify" and omit the words "including an empty search". An empty search has no entries, so the guidance is the same. I did not count the missing words as a gap.
- Substring assertions against the actual description text are an appropriate way to check wording-level requirements. A description that dropped or changed any asserted clause would fail the test.

I found no unacknowledged adequacy gap.

The `instructions` field supplied under {cite}`requirements.authoring.search_accounting.first_result` MUST contain the following text.

Before submitting your assessment, close every delivered search with finish_search({search_id, used:[tags]}). Submission fails while any search remains open. Include a tag only when you used information in its snippet to justify your conclusion without an additional source read. Entries whose source you subsequently read with habeas may be omitted; including them is harmless. Use used:[] when no entries qualify, including for an empty search. finish_search records dependencies and does not request more source.
